items.t: Sapperton, New Westminster: 14 houses sold at a median of $1,420,000, with the middle half between $1,252,175 and $1,536,875. The median house took 26 days to sell and closed at 97.4% of list.

42 condos sold in Sapperton, New Westminster at a median of $526,250 (middle half $444,625 to $569,625). A typical condo in Sapperton, New Westminster spent 37 days on the market and closed at 97.3% of the asking price.

How Sapperton compares with the rest of New Westminster

items.t: Houses in Sapperton have the 6th highest median of 9 New Westminster sub-areas, $1,420,000. Connaught Heights is lowest at $1,245,000 and Queens Park highest at $1,742,500. Uptown NW ($1,312,500) sits just below and The Heights NW ($1,420,000) sits just above.

Of 7 New Westminster sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, Sapperton ranks second lowest at $526,250; the range is $519,900 (Downtown New Westminster) to $690,000 (Queensborough). Downtown New Westminster ($519,900) sits just below and Uptown NW ($529,000) sits just above.
